articles.title: Congress demands Dept of War release 46 secret UFO videos : ‘You’re gonna see some weird f–king s–t’
articles.summary: Members of Congress are demanding 46 military videos from the Department of War, claiming insiders confirm proof of advanced, non-human craft operating on Earth. This congressional scrutiny highlights ongoing interest in Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAPs) and their potential national security implications. It underscores calls for transparency regarding advanced technologies and unknown aerospace phenomena, crucial for defence intelligence and strategic planning.

articles.title: India moves to boost defence indigenisation with EoI for 1,000-kg aerial bomb
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry has initiated the indigenous design and development of a 1000-kg aerial bomb, similar to the Mk-84, for the Indian Air Force. This crucial step aims to significantly boost India's 'Aatmanirbharta' (self-reliance) in critical defence manufacturing. It underscores the nation's commitment to reducing reliance on foreign imports and strengthening its national security capabilities through domestic production.

articles.title: Right to Education does not include right to choose school: Delhi HC
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has ruled that a child's right to education does not include the right to select a particular school. A bench of Chief Justice D K Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia clarified that the Right to Education Act ensures access to education, but not the freedom to pick any specific institution. This judgment defines the limits of the RTE Act regarding school choice.

articles.title: ISRO launches Mission MITRA in Ladakh to study astronaut behaviour in extreme conditions
articles.summary: ISRO is launching a mission in Ladakh to comprehensively study the physiological, psychological, and operational dynamics of 'gaganyatris' (astronauts). This crucial initiative aims to understand human adaptability and performance in challenging environments, essential for India's upcoming Gaganyaan human spaceflight mission. It reflects India's advanced preparations for sending humans to space, vital for future missions.

articles.title: Indian LPG carrier transits Strait of Hormuz; supplies, seafarers under watch: Report
articles.summary: India's large gas carrier, Green Sanvi, successfully transited the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz on Friday night, transporting 46,650 metric tonnes of LPG. This safe passage highlights India's ongoing efforts to secure its energy supplies and maintain unimpeded maritime trade through critical international waterways, particularly amidst regional geopolitical sensitivities impacting shipping routes.
